key_path: Fastest (MCP): add https://mcp.zapier.com/api/v1/connect as a connector in the MCP client, then sign in/sign up via OAuth; Zapier auto-provisions the server with actions for already-connected apps
CLI/SDK: `npx zapier-sdk signup --non-interactive` (or `--headless` for remote agents: the user opens the URL and pastes the callback URL back)
For CI: `npx zapier-sdk create-client-credentials "my-script"`; connection-token fallback created at mcp.zapier.com
Connect each third-party app (OAuth per app) before actions do anything useful
human_gates: admin approval of connector in managed orgs

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: zapier-sdk signup/login with browser or headless callback-paste mode, plus --non-interactive for agents
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes: OAuth from inside the MCP client; Zapier creates the server during sign-in
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: partial: connection token per MCP server (one server per client); tool bundles
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes: free plan with task allowance; each successful MCP tool call costs 2 tasks

product_mcp_remote.auth: OAuth (default) or connection token (Bearer header preferred over ?token=)

mcp.one_click: directory connectors in Claude/ChatGPT etc.; docs have 'Open in Claude Code / Cursor / VS Code / Codex' deeplinks that pre-fill a full setup prompt; `npx @zapier/install-zapier` install-router skill

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://docs.zapier.com/llms.txt (opens with a 'For AI agents' section: ALWAYS/NEVER rules, retired NLA warning)
docs_for_agents.llms_full_txt: https://docs.zapier.com/llms-full.txt (explicitly 'do not fetch for direct context')
docs_for_agents.md_pages: yes, plus 'Agent routing guidance' blocks on pages
docs_for_agents.agent_skills: `npx skills add zapier/sdk -y`; MCP onboarding skill
docs_for_agents.use_with_ai_page: https://docs.zapier.com/install.md (router: MCP vs SDK vs CLI)

score_justification: OAuth MCP that provisions itself on sign-in, a CLI signup built for agents including headless mode, and docs that route agents explicitly. Value still depends on the human connecting each app.
best_practice: Agent routing guidance in docs ('do not tell the user to create a server first'), plus 'Open in <agent>' deeplinks carrying a full step-by-step setup prompt, plus headless signup with callback-URL paste for agents running remotely
biggest_gap: Each downstream app still needs a human OAuth, and MCP calls cost tasks (2 per call) on small free quotas
notes: AI Actions / NLA are retired; docs warn agents not to recommend them.
